sections.heading: Why Nordwind
sections.intro: Three promises printed on every bag.

items.title: Roasted to order
items.body: Your batch goes into the drum only after you order — never warehouse stock.

items.title: Direct trade
items.body: We buy from four farms we visit every harvest and publish what we pay.

items.title: Carbon-neutral shipping
items.body: Every parcel travels by rail and bike courier, offset at the roastery.
